name: 蕭郁達
objective:
本課程內容包括控制閥、控制器之介紹，程序動態應答分析，閉還路控制系統分析，控制器調諧，頻率應答分析及串級控制系統之介紹
This course contents the introduction of control valve and controller, process dynamics, close loop control system, tuning of feedback controller, frequency response techniques, and cascade control system.
schedule:
Process Dynamics
Topic 1 – Mathematical Modeling of Chemical Processes
Topic 2 – Laplace Transforms
Topic 3 – Transfer Function Models
Topic 4 – Process Dynamic Behaviors

Process Control
Topic 5 – Control System Instrumentation
Topic 6 – Feedback Controllers
Topic 7 – Stability of Closed-Loop Control Systems
Topic 8 – PID Controller Tuning
Topic 9 – Frequency Response Analysis
Topic 10 – Cascade and Multiloop Control
materials:
1. Dale E. Seborg, Thomas F. Edgar, Duncan A. Mellichamp, Francis J. Doyle III, “Process Dynamics and Control Techniques”, 4th Ed., John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 2017.
2. Self-made materials
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: Prerequisite knowledge:Material and Energy Conservation, Calculus, Engineering Mathematics
